latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 0.9.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Other Changes
* and_rebase: use workdir() rather than .path().parent() by @Pear0 in https://github.com/tummychow/git-absorb/pull/191
* Extract structs that encode announcements to users by @blairconrad in https://github.com/tummychow/git-absorb/pull/194
* Add flag to create squash commits by @blairconrad in https://github.com/tummychow/git-absorb/pull/195
* Make output more human-readable by @blairconrad in https://github.com/tummychow/git-absorb/pull/200
* ci: add darwin arm64 (aarch64-apple-darwin) build target by @radiosilence in https://github.com/tummychow/git-absorb/pull/203
* Add --no-limit option by @p1k0chu in https://github.com/tummychow/git-absorb/pull/204
* Refrain from compiling debug-level messages out of release build by @blairconrad in https://github.com/tummychow/git-absorb/pull/208

## New Contributors
* @Pear0 made their first contribution in https://github.com/tummychow/git-absorb/pull/191
* @radiosilence made their first contribution in https://github.com/tummychow/git-absorb/pull/203
* @p1k0chu made their first contribution in https://github.com/tummychow/git-absorb/pull/204

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tummychow/git-absorb/compare/0.8.0...0.9.0
